8 API specification
[SWS_Fr_00098]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00307
⌈All API functions or global variables, whether they are specified or not shall follow the
naming scheme Fr_<name>, where the first letter of each word in <name> is written
uppercase and the remainder of the word lowercase.⌋
